value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: deterministic inclusion-minimal vertex separators over unresolved prerequisite paths, ordered by cardinality and id. All prerequisites are conjunctive; BLOCKS reverses orientation; hierarchy and RELATED are excluded. Frontier cuts unlock upstream plans, while immediatelyUnblocked reports direct eligibility; intermediate tasks still need completion. Full certified SDK reads retain terminal/external evidence. Goal-cone unknown nodes/statuses and cycles refuse with typed remedies. Separate graph/search receipts and hard input, work, state, size and output caps prevent false completeness. Validation: exhaustive small DAG oracle, non-git CLI with no git on PATH, bounded large graphs, behavioral revert, public tracker snapshot replay, unchanged npm/Bun gates.
